investigator.method: One bounded, unauthenticated GET of the discovery-supplied official_website via curl (descriptive User-Agent, redirects followed, no retries, no browser, no auth).

identity.notes: The retrieved page's own header states 'An independent guide to Palace Theatre / Shaftesbury Avenue, London W1D 5AY' — i.e. the site explicitly self-identifies as a third-party independent guide rather than the theatre operator's own first-party official presence. Address given on page (Shaftesbury Avenue) is also a discrepancy against the candidate's given address (Cambridge Circus, W1D 5AY) though both resolve to the same physical corner venue.

probe_history.reason: The single unauthenticated GET returned a real, current programme listing directly on the page — sufficient to reach an honest identity and music-relevance decision without escalating.

title.value: Harry Potter and the Cursed Child
title.notes: The homepage states directly: 'John Tiffany's nine-time Olivier Award-winning production Harry Potter and the Cursed Child plays at London's Palace Theatre' — a staged play, not a concert.

start_date.notes: The retrieved page shows an overall production run/season rather than individually dated performance instances in this bounded static probe.

venue_location.notes: The retrieved page states an address ('null') that does not match the candidate's given address ('Cambridge Circus, W1D 5AY, London').

reasons: The venue's own current programme, as retained directly from https://www.palacetheatrelondon.org/, is theatrical staged production(s) — 'Harry Potter and the Cursed Child' — not live music, concerts, or DJ/club-night performance.

The retrieved site's own tagline states 'An independent guide to Palace Theatre' — it explicitly self-describes as a third-party independent guide, not the theatre's own first-party official presence, despite the discovery-supplied URL being labelled official_website; this further weakens any activation case beyond the music-gate rejection alone.

evidence.description: Literal, contiguous excerpt of the real HTTP response body from the official site showing the current production listing.
evidence.method: curl; descriptive User-Agent; unauthenticated GET; redirects followed; bounded response; single request, no retry
